name: ReelToScript
tagline: Paste a short-video link, get a timestamped transcript
description: ReelToScript turns links to short videos on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts, Facebook, and X into timestamped transcripts you can export as TXT, SRT, or VTT. Paste a video link to get time-marked text for captions, editing, research, and notes. It is built for creators, editors, and teams working with short-form video. The first transcript is free, and free accounts can process up to three videos per day. Paid options include $5 credit packs, Pro at $9/month, and Agency at $24/month. ReelToScript transcribes linked videos; it does not create or publish videos.
